issues.issue: The same label is categorised differently in receipts (charges for services/fees) and in detail (Utility Charges). Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule, utility fund charges are Utility Charges.
This line mixes rent and miscellaneous income. Its detail_category is Rental Income, but the category is charges for services rather than Rentals. It is already marked for review.

Licenses and fees paid are not a utility bill. Under the cost-type rule, Other Taxes Paid (fees) or other fits better than 'utilities'. The detail lines (Water 7,213, Sewer 1,335) have the same issue.
